transports.anonymous: Execute anonymous: one compile problem with its line, or the tagged terminal assertion value.
transports.isTest: One class per insert in dependency order: the first compile problem, or the tagged @IsTest assertion value.
transports.deploy: Check-only deploy of every class: all compile problems in order, then the tagged @IsTest assertion value.

normalization: Named AO rows rename the base, subclass and test units to AOBase, AOSub and AOTest in sources, messages and values. M2 rows rename the companion class prefix to AOQuirk. Anonymous, PB, PC, AOJ, AOK, AOL and AOM rows are verbatim; AOJ, AOK and AOL anonymous rows compile their saved org base class as a project companion.
exclusions: No exported row carries a deferred native error. AO R014/C014 are not exported (type-versus-local lookup). Dependent class is invalid errors on deploy rows are retained but skipped by the comparison (dependency compile gate). API 68.0 covers only AO R006/C006/R010/C010 and the protected-access control C007 on anonymous and isTest routes.

notExported.rows: AO R014, C014 (API 62.0, 65.0, 66.0, 67.0; anonymous and isTest)
notExported.reason: Both rows are rejected natively with Variable does not exist: SObjectType, a type-versus-local name lookup in a method body, not an override rule.

notExported.rows: Dependent class is invalid and needs recompilation errors on the @IsTest class of PB21O, PB22O and the rejected AOJ, AOK, AOL and AOM deploy rows
notExported.reason: Kept in each row but skipped by the comparison. The deploy reports the dependent test class; semantic analysis reports only the rejected class.
